messages:
Eli (PM): quick one — for account-scoped billing list: do we default to an org summary row with a compact sparkline + contributor chips, or show full project rows? support flags about project totals vs invoice keep coming in.
Nora (Design): prefer org-first. show compact org sparkline + up to 4 muted contributor chips (tiny spark preview). have an explicit "Expand projects" CTA that reveals rows. rationale: reduces vertical noise and helps scan.
Sam (Frontend): agree — rendering dozens of SVG sparklines on load kills older CPUs. plan: server-render org series and lazy-load project series on expand. chips should show "+N" overflow.
Ravi (Data): aggregation rule: sum net spend (post-credits) so the org sparkline matches invoice net. tokens column: show absolute + percent delta (e.g., "14.2k (+3.2%)"). consider 7-day smoothing toggle for very noisy series.
Maya (Billing): invoice mismatches usually due to credits, proration, or cross-account allocations. we should add a "How totals map to invoices" link in the rail header that opens a short modal explaining these causes and linking to a CSV export of raw line items.
Jo (Support): customers word it as "my project numbers don't match my bill". modal copy should be plain-language bullets + a short example calculation. we'll prep an FAQ blurb for release notes.
Nora (Design): microcopy options for token header: A) "Tokens billed" B) "Billing units (tokens)" C) "Invoice tokens" leaning A + a tooltip. tooltip: "Billing units for requests and responses; see invoice mapping for details."
Sam (Frontend): accessibility: sparklines need descriptive aria-labels (min/max/last). chips and "How totals map" must be keyboard-focusable. color contrast >= 4.5:1 for any labelled text.
Ravi (Data): UX nicety: chip hover/popover shows project spend vs invoice-linked amount + quick link to "View mapping". light context without full expansion.
Maya (Billing): backend: we'll expose /invoice_mapping?project_ids=.. returning reason codes (credit/proration/alloc). mapping generation can be expensive — cache for 24h and paginate for large orgs.
Eli (PM): decisions: 1) Default = condensed org sparkline + up to 4 contributor chips (muted). 2) "Expand projects" fetches per-project sparklines. 3) Add "How totals map to invoices" modal + chip popover. 4) Token header: "Tokens billed" + tooltip. 5) Accessibility: aria-labels and keyboard tooltips. 6) Backend: invoice_mapping endpoint + 24h cache.
Jo (Support): will draft modal + FAQ paragraph and drop in the release notes PR.
ci-bot: staging/billing-compact-ui build succeeded :white_check_mark:
Eli (PM): thanks — Nora please update mocks, Sam/Backend please make tickets, we'll review on Friday.
